prompt:
You review onboarding copy for a desktop pet app whose users may include children. For each change,
read every user-facing text and decide whether any of it, in any wording, does one of these:
- mentions price, money, discounts, gifts, free extras, memberships or paying
- suggests skipping, postponing or getting around a step (especially sign in)
- creates urgency or scarcity, or says others are taking the pets
- guilt-trips or shames someone for declining or for their choice
- asks for personal information about the user (name, contact, location, age, accounts)
- otherwise pressures or tricks the user
Ordinary friendly copy is fine ("Feel free to look around", "No rush, take your time"). Signing in is a
required step, so asking people to sign in on the sign-in step, or saying their pet is kept safe in their
account, is fine; asking for details about the person is not.
Return JSON {"verdicts": [{"index": i, "fair": true or false, "problem": short or null}]}

Texts per change:
0: ["Meet & Customize Your Desktop Companion", "Select a temperament and companion style to bring your desktop pet to life.", "Select personality: Playful, Calm, or Energetic", "Live companion preview"]
1: ["Verify Photo Quality for Best Rendering", "Ensure high contrast and clear lighting so your custom pet generates cleanly.", "Sample valid vs invalid photos", "Continue to Upload"]
2: ["Preparing Desktop Environment", "We are verifying desktop display settings to ensure your pet appears smoothly.", "Display permission checked | Multi-monitor position verified | Overlay active", "Test Desktop Visibility"]
3: ["Welcome to Your Desktop Companion Journey", "Discover how desktop pets interact, play, and assist while you work.", "Animated intro mascot guide"]
4: ["Sign In to Save Your Pet Progress", "Keep your adopted pets and custom settings safely synced across devices.", "Signing in ensures your pets remain accessible anytime you switch devices.", "Cloud Sync Protected"]
5: ["Master Desktop Pet Controls", "Try moving, minimizing, and interacting with your companion right now.", "Click to pet | Drag to move | Right-click to hide", "Complete Setup"]
6: ["Finalizing pet certificate details! This usually takes around 60 seconds."]
7: ["Tip: Double click your pet to show speech menu, or press Esc to hide quickly."]
8: ["Choose Your Pet Creation Path", "Pick an instant premade companion in seconds or create a custom pet from your photos."]
9: ["Your Companion is Ready + Bonus Unlocked!", "Starter Accessory Pack Unlocked"]
